metadata.datasource: Measured off HARMAN technology, ILFORD ORTHO PLUS technical information (Oct 2019), ID-11 stock 8 min at 20 C, intermittent agitation: the lower of the sheet's two pictorial curves, G-bar 0.62 (Ilford calls 0.62-0.70 normal for camera use, and rates the film ISO 80 to daylight in ID-11 at normal contrast). Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 80; base + fog 0.067. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Ilford's wedge spectrogram to tungsten light, read as relative log sensitivity, as HP5 Plus's; Ortho Plus's own ratings, ISO 80 to daylight and 40 to tungsten, bear the reading out. Orthochromatic: the spectrogram ends at 565 nm, and the film sees nothing redder. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
